result.stdout:
USAGE:
    tap [upstream] [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

ARGUMENTS:
    [upstream]    Upstream URL to inspect/forward to (e.g.                      
                  http://localhost:3000). May also be set via tap.config or env 
                  TAP_UPSTREAM                                                  

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                                Prints help information           
        --proxy-port                          Inspector proxy port (default     
                                              4444)                             
        --ui-port                             Inspector UI port (default 4445)  
        --quick                               Spin up a TryCloudflare quick     
                                              tunnel and route it through the   
                                              inspector                         
        --token <TOKEN>                       Cloudflare connector token        
                                              (token-mode tunnel)               
        --api-token <TOKEN>                   Cloudflare API token              
                                              (Account:Cloudflare Tunnel:Edit + 
                                              Zone:DNS:Edit)                    
        --account <ID>                        Cloudflare account ID (required   
                                              for --api-managed and --dynamic)  
        --api-managed <NAME>                  Use the Cloudflare API to         
                                              create/reuse a named tunnel and   
                                              route HOSTNAME through it         
        --dynamic <ZONE>                      Mint a fresh hostname under ZONE  
                                              (uses --api-managed; pair with    
                                              --account/--api-token)            
        --hostname <FQDN>                     Public hostname for               
                                              token/api-managed mode            
        --docker                              Run cloudflared in a Docker       
                                              container                         
                                              (cloudflare/cloudflared:latest)   
        --auto-install                        If cloudflared is missing, install
                                              it via the host's package manager 
        --auth-header <NAME=VALUE>            Require an API key in this header 
                                              on the proxy                      
        --auth-cidr <CIDR>                    Allowlist source CIDR (repeatable)
        --auth-country <CC>                   Allowlist ISO country code        
                                              (CF-IPCountry, repeatable)        
        --auth-oidc-authority <URL>                                             
        --auth-oidc-client-id <ID>                                              
        --auth-oidc-client-secret <SECRET>                                      
        --config <PATH>                       Optional tap.config JSON file to  
                                              load defaults from                
    -v, --verbose                             Show ASP.NET Core framework logs  
                                              alongside the request log         
    -n, --name <NAME>                         Run a named profile from          
                                              ~/.config/tap/tunnels (or         
                                              %APPDATA%/tap/tunnels). CLI flags 
                                              override profile values           

COMMANDS:
    run                    Start the inspector and optionally a Cloudflare      
                           tunnel in front of an upstream URL. With no args,    
                           lists saved profiles                                 
    save <name>            Save a named tunnel profile to %APPDATA%/tap/tunnels 
                           (or ~/.config/tap/tunnels)                           
    rm <name>              Delete a saved tunnel profile                        
    install-cloudflared    Install the cloudflared binary via the host's package
                           manager
